why: A block a beat nobody has to play writes, and the server drops. The plate trap's payload runs only if the party springs it, so no configuration the critical path passes lays its write; the runtime arm lays every block-writing line of every function the load does not run, at once. A wall torch facing north hangs on the block south of it, and the cell south of the pedestal holds air at load and in every configuration any write can reach. The build refuses it, naming the torch's cell, the payload line that writes it and what stands south of it. It declares no unit: which block holds which is the pinned game's rule over blocks an effect already writes, and states no DSL surface.
